subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance evidence & PO routing
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@pangeasolutions.com>, procurement@pangeasolutions.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: insurance evidence & PO routing

Hi Elena —

Welcome — we're excited to get Pangea added to our vendor roster. To move your account to active and route a purchase order we need the following items from your side: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing the policy effective dates and limits. Minimums we require: Commercial General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate and Tech E&O $1M.
- Additional Insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 1500 Market Street, San Francisco, CA" (or the policy endorsement page that adds Additional Insured).
- Waiver of subrogation — please indicate if you can provide (preferred but negotiable).
- Completed W-9 (US vendors) or tax form equivalent.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) or confirmation that you completed our portal entry.

If you can send the COI + endorsements and W-9 by end of week (EOD Fri 09/10) we can create a draft PO and queue it for approval. If any of the endorsement language is not possible on your policy, let me know and we'll review with procurement/legal.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the checklist. Attaching our current COI and W-9. A couple of notes:

- COI_Pangea_Sept2026.pdf: our insurer listed Redwood Inference as certificate holder; policy limits meet the amounts you listed.
- We do not have an Additional Insured endorsement automatically included on the certificate. We can request an endorsement from our carrier but that may take a few business days.
- W9_Pangea.pdf included.

Are you able to accept the COI as-is for PO creation and then provide the endorsement within 5 business days? If Redwood requires the endorsement before PO issuance we can initiate the request immediately and share updates.

Attachments: COI_Pangea_Sept2026.pdf (application/pdf), W9_Pangea.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: insurance evidence & PO routing

Thanks Elena — received both files.

On initial review the COI shows the required limits, which is good, but the Additional Insured endorsement is not present. We need either:

1) An endorsement page from your insurer naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured, or
2) A signed policy endorsement that we can retain in the vendor file.

If you can provide one of the above within 5 business days we can proceed with PO activation upon receipt. If you expect a delay and need the PO queued earlier, Marcus (cc'd) can create a provisional/draft PO, but final approval and invoice processing will remain on hold until the endorsement is in the file.

To be explicit: sending the COI as certificate holder only is not sufficient for final activation. If you'd like, we can accept a commitment by your carrier (endorsement in progress) and put a conditional PO in the system while the endorsement is being produced. Please confirm how you'd like to proceed.
